cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I went outside when you did. If you're my friend, give me your place in the queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only went to collect my bag. The usher kept my place; you left altogether.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, coming back in order. Let me stand where you were.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's one ticket left. If I give you my place, I don't get in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll know you meant it when you said you'd help. Let me have that last ticket.

reason: Give S04 a particular misunderstood imitation which changes the Drive tactic. Preserve responsive B turns and explicitly stated essential facts; remove generic confidence prefaces.
